question: Does one-step CCIL supervision help an unchanged LeRobot ACT policy on PushT keypoints beyond adding the same amount of duplicated demonstration supervision?

policy.other: every other ACT setting at its LeRobot 0.6.1 default

selection.rule: the saved checkpoint with the lowest mean L2 action error on every frame of the held-out real episodes (CCIL's recorded split); ties go to the earlier checkpoint; simulator returns are never used

evaluation.note: synchronous vector environments: LeRobot 0.6.1's async workers do not import gym_pusht

analysis.interval: ilsb.analysis.paired: the union of a BCa bootstrap and a paired t interval over the five seeds, confidence 0.95, descriptive
analysis.signal: the mean primary contrast is above 0 and the primary contrast is positive on at least 4 of the 5 seeds; otherwise the pilot ends, and a null or unfavorable result is reported
